### Delete(string)

Deletes a directory tree after the servers using it have stopped.

```csharp
public static void Delete(string path)
```

Parameters:

`path` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The directory to delete. A missing directory is already deleted.

Exceptions:

- [IOException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.io.ioexception): A file remained in use or the directory could not be deleted.
- [UnauthorizedAccessException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.unauthorizedaccessexception): Access to a file or directory remained denied.

On Windows, a stopped server's processes can still hold handles to its files for a short time after
<code>pg_ctl stop</code> returns. Like PostgreSQL's own Windows <code>unlink</code>, deletion retries access and sharing
failures every 100 milliseconds for up to 10 seconds, then reports the last failure. Other platforms delete once.
